overview_description: Generate an ABA file from the transactions you name, such as purchase payments.
intro: This area generates ABA files. Send the transactions to include, such as purchase payments, and the API builds the file from them. This area has 1 endpoint, available in all seven SDKs.
notes: **The body is wrapped in `aba_file`.** List the transactions under `aba_file.transactions`.
**A transaction is named by its `id`.** The example passes a purchase payment `id`.

endpoints.title: Generate an ABA file
endpoints.summary: Generates an ABA file from the transactions you name.
endpoints.description: Generates an ABA file from transactions. Send the transactions under `aba_file.transactions`, for example the `id` of a purchase payment. The response body and its content type are not documented yet.

transactions.description: The transactions to include, such as purchase payment ids.

200.description: The ABA file is generated. The response body and its content type are not documented yet.
